messages:
matt: Quick heads up: scheduling runtime v2.4 canary tonight across EU -> US. Canary 1% then staged ramp. Need console + router handshake and telemetry gate. Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. cc @olivia @sanjay

olivia: ack. will prepare console feature-flag flip. what exact telemetry thresholds?

sanjay: router needs header split compatibility for x-rw-model-version. router should accept both header forms for at least 30m during canary. will spray 1% traffic.

matt: telemetry gate = runtime_token_p95, generation_error_rate, kv_eviction_anomaly. targets: p95 < 220ms, gen_errors < 0.8%, no eviction spikes. any breach -> immediate rollback/pin to v2.3.

amy: deploy-bot preflight flagged console schema change for structured outputs. @olivia please confirm console rollout steps.

olivia: console plan: 02:05 expose schema v2 opt-in, 02:20 enable for 10% UI traffic, 02:30 enable for canary route. will publish runbook in ~10m.

deploy-bot: Preflight OK: infra quotas OK, reserved GPUs available, service tokens valid. starting canary at 1719555565. canary -> 1% eu-prod.

matt: ops note: if gen_errors >= 1% for 5m OR p95 > 300ms for 3m -> pause + rollback. amy to own pin. ops-oncall watch for 5xx spikes.

ops-oncall: setting alerts: "runtime_generation_error_rate > 0.8% for 5m" and "runtime_p95 > 300ms for 3m" -> page SEV2.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @+3m: tokens/sec 1200, generation_errors 0.2%, p95 180ms, kv_evictions baseline. no gates tripped.

amy: starting canary verification: sample top-20 prompts, rerank smoke, structured output parsing.

matt: sanjay please run header-swap smoke: 0.5% with x-rw-model-version=v2.4 and 0.5% without. ensure console accepts both.

sanjay: header-swap started at 1719555585. initial: ~0.03% schema parse mismatch reported by console. tagging @olivia.

olivia: saw mismatch. applying quick tolerance patch to ignore extra field. will re-run parsing. note added to release notes.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @+10m: tokens/sec 1500, generation_errors 0.5%, p95 210ms. telemetry gate passing.

matt: good. plan staged ramp: 5% at 02:30, 25% at 02:45 if healthy. rollback/pin command:
# pin to previous stable
cloudctl runtime pin --service runtime --version v2.3 --reason "auto-rollback: canary breach"

amy: acknowledged. will pin on threshold and mark canary signal-block in notes.

ops-oncall: monitoring kv_eviction signals for correlation to latency, will escalate if seen.

matt: any blockers before 5% at 02:30?

olivia: console ready, flag schedule set.

sanjay: router config OK, keeping compatibility for 1hr post-ramp.

amy: rollback plan complete, release notes updated, release-manager checklist done.

deploy-bot: staged ramp scheduled: 5% at 1719555600, 25% at 1719555700. notifying #eng-releases #prod-telemetry #ops.

matt: thanks team. monitoring first 30m then signoff for full rollout. :thumbsup:
